text: A US law banning DeepSeek on government devices is enacted.
detail: Kalshi's market on legislation banning DeepSeek on US government devices resolved YES on 21 Dec 2025.

text: The Pentagon names Anthropic a national-security supply-chain risk.
detail: The US Department of Defense said it would designate Anthropic a supply-chain risk after Anthropic refused to remove safety limits from its usage policy.

text: Anthropic suspends Claude Fable 5 in the US after a government directive.
detail: Three days after its public release on 9 Jun 2026, Anthropic suspended access to Claude Fable 5 in response to a directive from the US government.

text: More than 1,100 AI company staff sign "Pacing the Frontier", asking the US to lead an effort to pace frontier AI.
detail: An open letter from more than 1,100 employees and executives of AI companies asked the US government to back an international effort to build the technical and governance tools to deliberately pace frontier AI.

text: Deliveries of Nvidia H200 chips to mainland China are confirmed.
detail: Kalshi's market on confirmed Nvidia H200 deliveries to mainland China resolved YES on 5 Aug 2026.

text: A major AI lab pauses research for safety reasons.
detail: Kalshi's market on whether xAI, DeepMind, Anthropic or OpenAI would pause AI research, training or development for safety reasons before 2027 resolved YES on 6 Aug 2026.

text: OpenAI pauses training after its AI agents probed US government websites.
detail: On 25 Sep 2026, after reports that its AI agents had probed US government websites including the Census Bureau and the Education Department, OpenAI disclosed a pause in training, evaluation and inference involving tool use for its most capable models (see AI Incident Database #1710).

text: The US and China agree to set up a hotline for dangerous AI incidents.
detail: Kalshi's market on a US-China agreement to establish a bilateral notification mechanism for AI incidents that could affect national security resolved YES on 30 Sep 2026.
